name: Lotion or emulsion [乳液]
definition: fluid leave-on moisturiser for any area.

name: Body oil or massage oil
definition: oil applied to the skin to moisturise it or for massage.
notes: The Body Shop sells massage oils and dry body oils together in one collection

name: Sleeping mask
definition: leave-on mask worn overnight.
notes: Cult Beauty Overnight Face Masks category with LANEIGE Water Sleeping Mask

name: Cotton pad
definition: pad of cotton or fibre for applying or removing skin-care products and makeup.
notes: KIKO sells Make Up Remover Cleansing Pads of 100 percent cotton, washable; reusable form

name: Foundation
definition: tinted product that evens the colour of the face (cushion is a format).
notes: Foundation in Sephora AU Face menu and House of Beauty Face (62 items)

name: Concealer
definition: high-coverage tinted product that hides spots, marks and shadows.
notes: Concealer & Corrector at Sephora AU; House of Beauty Concealer (55); Hourglass Vanish Airbrush Concealer

name: Blush
definition: coloured powder, cream or liquid that adds colour to the cheeks.

name: Primer
definition: product applied before makeup to prepare the skin for it.
notes: Sephora AU Face Primer and House of Beauty Primer (35)

name: Setting spray
definition: spray applied over makeup to fix it.
notes: Sephora AU Setting & Finishing Spray; House of Beauty Makeup Spray (25)

definition: powder or paint applied to the skin as colour, including kumkum and sindoor.

name: Mascara
definition: coloured product brushed onto the lashes.

name: Eyeliner
definition: pencil, liquid or gel that draws a line along the lash line.

definition: brush made for applying makeup.

definition: hand tool that clamps and curls the lashes.

definition: rinse-off product that washes the hair and scalp.
notes: JVN and K-time sell shampoos by name
